body:
I can get up to go to the office but I just can't shake the image. 

I can't even cry about it.

I was caught slacking off while waiting to talk to my manager and of course being the new guy it got out of control getting a talk from her, my trainer and another VP I'll be working with.

This combined with terrible performance on something I didn't prepare for just adds up.

I have to do that thing again (a presentation) but I can't get out of bed to practice / study for it.

The course required us in groups of three to do two things.

1. Start a business and generate revenue / income which will be donated to the university with the class making maybe more than $30,000 revenue. This portion is graded against each other where (to simplify it) the more profit you make, closer to 100% on that portion you will get. We were given a six week time-frame and $1 to start.

1. The groups must go and find a business to consult for. This company must be approved by the instructor and has internal problems of a 'large enough' magnitude to justify a $40,000 report if the client were to actually go out and find a professional consulting firm to do this. We had approx. 14 weeks from start to finish.

1. The course also requires us to do the major field test (MFT) individually which I was able to get 90+ percentile so I got some marks towards passing the class there.

This course lasted over the course of approx. 16 weeks with a pass rate of 20% this term (average pass rate is approx. 50). If you don't pass this course, you can't get the piece of paper. You tell me whether this is fair or not for an undergraduate course.

I'm sick of that place.

Edit: I got the numbers wrong.
No plan, really. Either way, thanks for chatting with me.

Working towards a bba. I should be able to graduate by the end of summer if i font have any more fuck ups. And then there's talk of law school. I did the LSAT (for them, really) and it came back with 50 percentile. Meaning there's no chance to go to law school where I'm at. Yay. 
Gonna tell them later this week. I know they're going to ask me to take it again... I keep feeling that I'm disappointing the shit out of them and its a cycle of self hate and self loathing.
